source.documentTitle: Turbo Air Condensing Unit - Model TS060XR404A3A

commonFeatures.detail: Manufacturer states the coating increases coil life.
Designed to improve heat exchange by reducing fin-to-tube spacing.

commonFeatures.feature: Externally accessible control box and service valves

commonFeatures.detail: Stabilizes liquid-line operation and limits flash-gas formation under low ambient conditions.

commonFeatures.feature: Prepainted galvanized cabinet on a heavy-duty steel base
UL, cUL and ISO 9001 approvals stated by manufacturer

notes: The R404A table contains 32 published capacity points.
The supplied model sheet does not state compressor superheat, return-gas temperature, subcooling, or a 50 Hz conversion factor.
The temperature columns are stored as saturated suction temperature because Turbo Air's catalog identifies the same performance-table axis as suction temperature/SST.
Do not extrapolate beyond 90-110 F ambient or 0 to -40 F suction temperature.

powerRatingAvailability.preferredFutureSource: Installed three-phase power meter or a manufacturer input-power map for TS060XR404A3A

compressor.lowTemperatureCoolingProvision: Head-pressure control is documented; any compressor liquid-injection configuration must be verified from the installed unit.

capacityTable.interpolationPolicy: Linear interpolation is allowed only between adjacent published ambient and suction-temperature points after confirming the live suction input represents SST.
capacityTable.extrapolationPolicy: Never extrapolate beyond the published table envelope.

calculationWarnings: The supplied sheet does not publish nominal horsepower; leave horsepower unassigned until the unit nameplate or an explicit manufacturer source confirms it.
RLA and LRA are electrical ratings, not live current readings and not a substitute for measured real power.
MCA and MOPD are circuit-sizing references, not operating amperage targets.
The 31 lb value is explicitly a receiver-at-90-percent value and must not be relabeled as an 80-percent pump-down capacity or installed system charge.
AWEF 3.2 is a manufacturer rating; do not treat it as live efficiency.
Capacity interpolation requires verified ambient/entering-air temperature and saturated suction temperature.
